name: 寒冰能量球·冰川沉船墓场
desc: 15秒单镜第一人称：冰川峡谷的冰封沉船墓场中，主角以寒冰能量球冻结与碎裂，最终击杀蛇形冰川利维坦，全程剧烈甩头与手持失稳。
original: Single continuous shot, first-person POV perspective, the camera IS her eyes, hyper-chaotic handheld motion, completely unstabilized, violent raw human movement, constant micro-jitters, aggressive head swings, abrupt jerks, frequent over-rotation and harsh correction, moments of near motion blur loss, no smoothness at all, no stabilization, wide-angle lens (strong distortion), subtle chromatic aberration near frame edges, 15 seconds, her hands always visible in frame, no music only raw SFX, cinematic lighting, photorealistic, grounded realism, strong 35mm film look, heavy film grain, sharp but imperfect focus, noticeable focus breathing, motion blur on fast actions, halation on highlights, soft highlight rolloff, slightly desaturated tones, ARRI ALEXA aesthetic, practical VFX feel, minimal CGI look, natural imperfections Location: A massive frozen ship graveyard trapped inside a collapsed glacial canyon. Dozens of enormous rusted cargo ships are embedded at impossible angles within thick blue ice walls, as if the ocean itself flash-froze mid-collapse. The ground is a chaotic mix of cracked ice sheets, frozen ropes, broken hull fragments, and deep narrow crevasses emitting cold vapor. Snow blows violently through the canyon in sharp horizontal gusts, reducing visibility and constantly interacting with the lens. Ice surfaces are semi-transparent, revealing trapped air bubbles, dark silhouettes, and faint movement deep below. Action: Her hand slams down onto the ice — it fractures unnaturally, not from impact but from resonance — she pulls upward and a dense, translucent mass of vibrating crystal forms around her forearms [VFX: glass-like structures rapidly growing, refracting light, emitting low-frequency distortion ripples in the air]. The ground responds — something is moving beneath the ice. Enemies emerge — tall, emaciated humanoid forms made of layered frost and shattered ice plates, their bodies semi-transparent with dark hollow cores, moving in sharp, unnatural jerks like broken stop-motion. She engages instantly — first strike, she grabs one mid-lunge and compresses it, its body collapsing inward into a dense shard cluster before exploding outward in razor fragments. Second attack — she punches the ground, sending a directional shockwave through the ice, causing spikes to erupt upward beneath multiple enemies, impaling and freezing them mid-motion. The entire canyon suddenly shifts — a colossal serpentine glacier leviathan bursts through the surface, its body composed of layered ice slabs and frozen debris, with a massive hollow skull-like head and a deep glowing core buried within its throat. It lunges — she dodges violently, slipping across ice, nearly losing balance (camera over-rotates, harsh correction). She slams both hands into the surface — crystal structures spread rapidly, forming jagged paths — she sprints along them, gaining height toward the creature. It roars, releasing a freezing shockwave — visible distortion freezing moisture mid-air. She leaps directly toward its head, grabs onto its surface, fingers embedding into ice, climbs rapidly as the creature thrashes, reaches the exposed throat core — RAMPS TO SLOW MOTION as she pulls both hands back, crystal structures intensifying, then drives them forward into the core — the entire body begins to fracture from within, cracks spreading in glowing lines — SNAPS BACK — catastrophic rupture, the leviathan collapses into a cascading avalanche of ice and ship debris. She is thrown upward by the force — camera violently shakes — both hands visible, still covered in cracking crystal energy — looking down as the entire frozen graveyard collapses and shifts beneath her. SFX: howling wind, ice creak stress, deep glacier cracking, low frequency hum, crystal growth resonance, sharp ice fracture snaps, enemy twitch crack sounds, shard explosion, ice spike eruption, rapid crawling skitter, deep sub-surface rumble, massive breach explosion, leviathan roar (low, hollow, pressure-heavy), freezing shockwave boom, sliding metal hull collapse, slow-motion ice stress groan, core fracture resonance, avalanche roar, debris cascade, heavy impact wind rush Total: 15s / 1 shot / 16:9
src: 用户直供·Seedance2.0提示词合集｜能量球：寒冰
zh: 单次连续镜头，第一人称 POV 视角，摄影机就是她的双眼；极度混乱的手持运动，完全不稳定，呈现猛烈、原始的人体运动；持续细微抖动、激烈甩头、突然抽动、频繁过度旋转和强硬纠正，某些瞬间几乎因运动模糊而丢失画面；完全不平滑、不使用稳定器；广角镜头并带强烈畸变，画面边缘有轻微色差；时长 15 秒，她的双手始终出现在画面中；无音乐，只有原始音效；电影级灯光、照片级写实、扎实的现实感、强烈的 35mm 胶片风格、明显胶片颗粒；对焦清晰但不完美，具有明显的呼吸效应；快速动作带运动模糊，高光有晕光与柔和过渡；色彩略微降低饱和度，呈现 ARRI ALEXA 美学、实拍特效质感、尽量弱化 CGI 感，并保留自然瑕疵。 地点：一座巨大的冰封沉船墓场，被困在已经坍塌的冰川峡谷内部。数十艘锈蚀的巨型货轮以违背常理的角度嵌入厚重的蓝色冰壁，仿佛海洋在崩塌过程中被瞬间冻结。地面由破裂冰层、冻结缆绳、破碎船体残片以及不断冒出寒雾的狭长深裂隙混杂组成。暴雪以尖锐的水平阵风猛烈穿过峡谷，降低能见度，并持续拍打和干扰镜头。冰面呈半透明状态，可以看见被困其中的气泡、黑暗轮廓，以及冰层深处若隐若现的运动。 动作：她将手掌猛砸在冰面上，冰层以不自然的方式裂开，并非源于物理撞击，而是由共振造成。她向上抬手，一团致密、半透明且不断振动的晶体包覆双侧前臂。[视觉特效：玻璃般的结构迅速生长并折射光线，在空气中释放低频扭曲波纹。] 地面随之产生回应，冰层下方有某种东西正在移动。 敌人出现：高大而瘦削的人形生物由层叠霜冻与破碎冰甲构成，身体半透明，内部有黑暗空洞的核心；它们以尖锐、反常的抽搐动作移动，如同损坏的定格动画。她立即迎战。第一次攻击：一只敌人腾空扑来时，她将其抓住并压缩，它的身体向内坍缩成致密的碎片团，随后爆成向外飞射的剃刀状冰片。第二次攻击：她一拳击向地面，让定向冲击波沿冰层传播，多根冰刺从数个敌人脚下猛然升起，将它们刺穿并冻结在动作进行之中。 整座峡谷突然位移震动，一条巨大的蛇形冰川利维坦破冰而出。它的身体由层叠冰板和冻结残骸构成，头部如同巨大而中空的骷髅，喉咙深处埋藏着一枚发光核心。它猛扑过来，她激烈闪避，在冰面上打滑并几乎失去平衡，摄影机过度旋转后又被强硬纠正。她将双手猛按在冰面上，晶体结构迅速扩散，形成高低错落的尖锐路径。她沿着晶体道路疾跑，不断提升高度并接近怪物。 它发出怒吼并释放冻结冲击波，空气中的可见扭曲将水汽直接冻结。她迎着怪物头部跃去，抓住其表面，手指深深嵌入冰层。怪物猛烈翻腾，她则快速攀爬，抵达裸露的喉部核心。画面逐渐进入慢动作：她向后收回双手，晶体结构的能量不断增强，随后将双手猛刺进核心。怪物整个身体开始从内部破裂，裂纹以发光线条的形式迅速扩散。画面突然恢复正常速度，发生灾难性爆裂，利维坦坍塌成倾泻而下的冰雪与船体残骸洪流。爆炸力量将她抛向空中，摄影机猛烈震动。她的双手仍清晰可见，并覆盖着不断开裂的晶体能量。她向下俯瞰，整座冰封沉船墓场正在下方坍塌和位移。 音效：呼啸狂风、冰层承压吱嘎声、深层冰川断裂、低频嗡鸣、晶体生长共振、尖锐冰裂爆响、敌人抽搐时的碎裂声、碎片爆炸、冰刺破土而出、快速爬行窸窣声、地表下方的深沉隆隆声、巨大破冰爆炸、利维坦的低沉空洞高压怒吼、冻结冲击波轰鸣、金属船体滑动坍塌、慢动作中的冰层承压呻吟、核心破裂共振、雪崩轰响、残骸倾泻、强烈冲击形成的风啸。 总计：15 秒 / 1 个镜头 / 16:9
